stem:
Urvashi divides $37.5$ by $1000$ by moving the decimal point.

Which two claims correctly state the result?

One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Move the decimal point three places to the left to get $0.0375$.
Move the decimal point three places to the right to get $37500$.
Move the decimal point one place to the left to get $3.75$, because $1000$ starts with $1$.

teacher.key_rationale: 1000 has three zeroes, so move the decimal three places left: 0.0375. Moving right swaps multiply for divide; moving only one place omits the three-zero count.
